items.text: Ravens finalizing trade for Cardinals QB Jacoby Brissett after Lamar Jackson (thumb) requires surgery and heads to IR (potentially season-ending); Tyler Huntley also out with season-ending turf toe. Deal expected completed this weekend; Fagnano likely starts Thursday vs JAX.
items.why: Thumb injury on first snap back; surgery needed; Huntley turf toe SE.
items.implication: Ravens QB carousel; short-term Fagnano, then Brissett; pass volume likely rises.
items.opportunity: Increased pass attempts for Flowers/Andrews/Henry receiving; Brissett volume bull case.

items.text: AJ Brown misses another game due to lingering knee issue (DNP Wednesday, ankle/knee); ETR flags as key Week 9 development alongside Lamar and JT sagas.
items.why: Recurring knee flare-up after ankle recovery; multiple DNPs.
items.implication: NE WR depth elevated; Hollins return from IR helps fill void.
items.opportunity: Targets to remaining NE WRs/TE; monitor Hollins activation.

items.text: Simplest bull case for Ravens pass game with Brissett: less efficiency mitigated by more volume. Lamar had 35+ attempts in only 15% of starts; Brissett 47% of his starts.
items.why: Career attempt rates show Brissett throws more often.
items.implication: Ravens WRs/TEs see higher target volume ROS while Lamar out.
items.opportunity: Route/target share expansion for primary pass catchers.

items.text: ETR/Levitan/Silva on SEA backfield with Charbonnet and Jadarian Price returns: 'gonna be like Charbonnet/Walker expect with worse versions of the players.' Committee expected.
items.implication: Neither a clear RB1; volume diluted ROS.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry share split; prefer Charbonnet slightly per some.

items.text: 49ers: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) and Mike Evans DNP Wednesday; Nick Bosa returns to practice. Shanahan has no expectation for Aiyuk.
items.why: Hamstring for CMC; Achilles-related for Evans.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday; Black or backups could see more if limited.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup snaps if CMC sits or limited; Evans absence boosts other SF WRs.

items.text: Wheels completely fall off for IND, Jonathan Taylor saga continues (limited Wednesday, ongoing uncertainty).
items.why: Ongoing saga per ETR team-by-team; practice limited.
items.implication: IND RB committee or backup elevation risk; monitor full reports.
items.opportunity: Handcuff value if sits; pace-up game vs DAL helps whoever plays.

items.text: ETR waiver: Mike Washington Jr. handed LV workhorse role Week 8 (25-2 carry edge over Ashton Jeanty); sticky TBD but workload noteworthy. Jeanty snaps/carries plummeted to career lows.
items.why: Kubiak decision; Washington 60% snaps/25 carries vs Jeanty 40%/2.
items.implication: Jeanty value now more receiving-dependent; Washington waiver priority.
items.opportunity: Jeanty routes/targets on passing downs; monitor if split reverts.
items.conflict: Jeanty still efficient through air on limited touches.

items.text: Cowboys 2-TE sets even with Ferguson injured early. WR routes on 38 Dak dropbacks: Lamb 29, Flournoy 26, Pickens 25, Mingo 7. Even distribution.
items.why: Post-game route counts show no clear hierarchy beyond Lamb slight edge.
items.implication: Pickens/Flournoy viable but capped; Lamb still lead.
items.opportunity: Even target competition; Flournoy waiver appeal.
items.conflict: Jerry Jones wants more Pickens ball.

items.text: Rams open window for TE Terrance Ferguson (practice today). Last full game (Wk2, Nacua out): 42% slot/wide, 70% routes on dropbacks, 29% target share (Adams played).
items.why: Prior high involvement when primary WR out.
items.implication: Potential TE target thief or flex if role sticks; impacts Nacua/Adams slightly if volume shared.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets in 12 personnel or empty; red-zone upside.

items.text: ETR Snaps & Pace Week 9: Up in pace DAL @ IND (high total, fast neutral). Slow slogs HOU @ LAC. Other slate notes.
items.why: Neutral pace/POE data; dome, weak defenses, projected 51.5 total.
items.implication: Elevated play volume for skill players in DAL-IND.

items.text: Yes, I am KEEPING IT OPEN on Ladd McConkey this week. As a WR3. Let’s not get carried away.
items.why: Maintains WR3 viability despite any recent noise.
items.opportunity: Target share in LAC offense remains solid.

items.text: Did Jerry Jones say George Pickens needs the ball more? Yes. Does that change anything for fantasy football? Not really.
items.why: Coach/owner comments rarely move needle without usage proof.
items.implication: No major upgrade; monitor actual routes/targets.
items.conflict: Levitan notes even route distribution recently.

items.text: Zach Charbonnet or Jadarian Price ROS? Give me CHARB!
items.why: Prefers Charbonnet's established role/usage over Price in committee.
items.implication: Charbonnet higher ROS ranking/start priority in split.

items.text: Ryan Flournoy has scored double-digit fantasy points in FOUR straight games. Why is he still sitting on your waiver wire?! Priority WR waiver target.
items.why: Consistent double-digit production; DAL WR depth usage.
items.implication: Add for depth/flex; aligns with even route shares.
